name: Deck building
summary: New decks priced from framing and decking square feet, footings, stairs, railing and tear-out.

items.label: Frame and deck, pressure-treated, 3 ft up
items.source: PT framing 0.10 h/sf x 1.25 guard multiplier + 0.35/100 post h/sf + decking 0.12 h/sf; decking $3.80/sf x 1.08 waste + framing $4.20/sf x 1.25 (MATERIAL_PRESETS pt, HEIGHT_GUARD_*); 14x20 + 10x12 sections at 3 ft (index.html STARTING sections)

items.label: Footings
items.source: estimatedFootings: ceil(280/49)=6 + max(4, ceil(120/49))=4; $85 each (DEFAULT_FOOTING_EACH, index.html footingEach); the specialist puts no hours on footings

items.label: Stair run, 4 ft wide, 5 risers
items.source: 4.5 + 5 x 0.18 + 4 x 0.25 h; $85 + 5 x $14 + 4 x $18 parts (STAIR_* constants); 1 run 4 ft x 5 risers (index.html STARTING_STAIRS)

items.label: Wood railing
items.source: RAILING_PRESETS wood 0.45 h/lf, $28/lf; 46 lf default (index.html railingLf)

items.label: Tear out existing deck and dispose
items.source: DEMO_HOURS_PER_SF 0.08; disposal $2.40/sf (DEFAULT_DISPOSAL_PER_SF, index.html disposalPerSf); 280 sf default (index.html demoSf)

items.label: Permit and other job cost
items.source: permit $175 + other job cost $40 (index.html permitCost, otherCost)

specialistModels: Height-above-grade framing and post multipliers, per-section materials (cedar, composite, PVC), span-based footing counts, railing styles and multiple stair runs.
